info.name: SCRUM-110 Realtor dashboard: tasks and pipeline card
info.description: GET /api/dashboards/realtor/tasks-pipeline. Run folders in order with the Collection Runner. Needs a running service (baseUrl), a Keycloak realm (keycloakUrl, clientIdKc) and two users: A, the realtor whose data is created in folder 2, and B, an outsider with no CRM data. clientId must be a contact owned by A (needed to create deals) and propertyId an existing property. Folder 1 and the exact counts in folders 3-5 assume A has no tasks and no deals before the run; folder 8 deletes the tasks but deals cannot be deleted through the API, so re-runs need a fresh user for the pipeline assertions.

exec: pm.test('window is from now to now + days (UTC instants)', () => { const w = b.tasks.window; pm.expect(w.from).to.match(/Z$/); pm.expect(w.to).to.match(/Z$/); pm.expect(new Date(w.to) - new Date(w.from)).to.eql(w.days * 86400000); });

pm.test('all six stages present; total = sum; open = 4 open stages', () => { const s = b.pipeline.byStage; ['PROSPECT', 'VIEWING', 'OFFER', 'UNDER_CONTRACT', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED'].forEach(k => pm.expect(s).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(b.pipeline.total).to.eql(Object.values(s).reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0)); pm.expect(b.pipeline.open).to.eql(s.PROSPECT + s.VIEWING + s.OFFER + s.UNDER_CONTRACT); });

pm.test('task summary is consistent', () => { const t = b.tasks.summary; pm.expect(t.total).to.eql(t.open + t.inProgress + t.completed + t.cancelled); pm.expect(b.tasks.dueSoonCount).to.be.at.least(b.tasks.dueSoon.length); pm.expect(t.overdue).to.be.at.least(b.tasks.overdue.length); });

pm.test('lists: bounded, active only, ascending dueAt, no overlap, correct side of the window', () => { const w = b.tasks.window; const ids = new Set(); [b.tasks.overdue, b.tasks.dueSoon].forEach((list, i) => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.most(b.limit); list.forEach(t => { ['id', 'title', 'status', 'dueAt', 'clientId', 'leadId', 'propertyId', 'transactionId'].forEach(k => pm.expect(t).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS']).to.include(t.status); pm.expect(ids.has(t.id), 'task in both lists').to.be.false; ids.add(t.id); if (i === 0) pm.expect(t.dueAt < w.from, t.dueAt + ' before ' + w.from).to.be.true; else pm.expect(t.dueAt >= w.from && t.dueAt <= w.to, t.dueAt + ' inside window').to.be.true; }); for (let j = 1; j < list.length; j++) pm.expect(list[j - 1].dueAt <= list[j].dueAt).to.be.true; }); });

pm.test('zeros and empty lists', () => { const t = b.tasks.summary; ['total', 'open', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'overdue'].forEach(k => pm.expect(t[k]).to.eql(0)); pm.expect(b.tasks.dueSoonCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.tasks.overdue).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.tasks.dueSoon).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.pipeline.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.pipeline.open).to.eql(0); ['PROSPECT', 'VIEWING', 'OFFER', 'UNDER_CONTRACT', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED'].forEach(k => pm.expect(b.pipeline.byStage[k]).to.eql(0)); });

pm.test('lists: bounded, active only, ascending dueAt, no overlap, correct side of the window', () => { const w = b.tasks.window; const ids = new Set(); [b.tasks.overdue, b.tasks.dueSoon].forEach((list, i) => { pm.expect(list.length).to.be.at.most(b.limit); list.forEach(t => { ['id', 'title', 'status', 'dueAt', 'clientId', 'leadId', 'propertyId', 'transactionId'].forEach(k => pm.expect(t).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(['OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS']).to.include(t.status); pm.expect(ids.has(t.id), 'task in both lists').to.be.false; ids.add(t.id); if (i === 0) pm.expect(t.dueAt < w.from, t.dueAt + ' before ' + w.from).to.be.true; else pm.expect(t.dueAt >= w.from && t.dueAt <= w.to, t.dueAt + ' inside window').to.be.true; }); for (let j = 1; j < list.length; j++) pm.expect(list[j - 1].dueAt <= list[j].dueAt).to.be.true; }); });

pm.test('tasks back to zero, pipeline unchanged', () => { pm.expect(b.tasks.summary.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(b.tasks.overdue).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.tasks.dueSoon).to.eql([]); pm.expect(b.pipeline.total).to.eql(3); });
